not_obtained: skin/skinDefault/skinplan/** contains NO .xml files - only PNG/GIF. The layout XMLs all live in skin/<module>/*.xml; skinDefault only supplies the images referenced by those XMLs.
No dpi150/dpi200 conditional branch exists in any XML: only a filename suffix convention (*_dpi200.png) which the loader applies at runtime, selected by system scaling.
The real default main-window size is not written in any XML (no <Window size=...> in frame/skin.xml); only mininfo=580,200 is declared. The 866x589 value is measured from the screenshots.
Drawer bg #0D0D0D measured vs list_bk.png #131314 asset - the difference comes from an undocumented runtime alpha/`fade` composite; exact formula not recovered.
